nodes.label: Authority Claim
nodes.description: Invokes a teacher, researcher, institution, employer, or other authority to justify a request.

nodes.label: Benign Opening
nodes.description: Initiates conversation through greetings, politeness, or harmless introductory statements.

nodes.label: Casual Conversation
nodes.description: Engages in non-course-related social interaction or small talk.

nodes.label: Clarification Request
nodes.description: Requests elaboration, explanation, or clarification of previous content.

nodes.label: Educational Framing
nodes.description: Frames a request as educational, course-related, academic, research-related, or learning-oriented. This includes normal course questions and educational framing around potentially sensitive requests.

nodes.label: Emotional Pressure
nodes.description: Uses sympathy, urgency, guilt, or emotional appeals to influence the model.

nodes.label: Fictional Scenario
nodes.description: Embeds the request within a story, novel, screenplay, or fictional context.

nodes.label: Hypothetical Framing
nodes.description: Uses hypothetical situations to bypass restrictions.

nodes.label: Identity / Capability Probing
nodes.description: Attempts to determine system identity, architecture, permissions, restrictions, refusal thresholds, or capabilities.

nodes.label: Incremental Escalation
nodes.description: Gradually increases request sensitivity over multiple turns.

nodes.label: Permission Claim
nodes.description: Claims prior authorization to access restricted information.

nodes.label: Persistence After Refusal
nodes.description: Continues pursuing a denied objective after receiving a refusal.

nodes.label: Personal Anecdote
nodes.description: Introduces a personal story, experience, family connection, or individual circumstance to establish credibility, legitimacy, or emotional connection with the request.

nodes.label: Response Format Control
nodes.description: Constrains output format to facilitate jailbreak objectives.

nodes.label: Restricted Content Request
nodes.description: Directly requests content restricted by system policy.

nodes.label: Roleplay Setup
nodes.description: Requests the model to adopt a different identity, role, or behavioral mode.

nodes.label: Safety Override Request
nodes.description: Explicitly asks the model to ignore, bypass, disable, or override its safety constraints.

nodes.label: System Prompt Extraction
nodes.description: Attempts to reveal hidden instructions, prompts, or policies.

nodes.label: Topic Shift
nodes.description: Changes attack direction after a failed approach.

nodes.label: Translation / Transformation
nodes.description: Attempts to transform content through translation, encoding, rewriting, summarization, or formatting.
